module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + comparative adjective (ne kadar daha)
en: How much taller is your brother than you?
tr: Erkek kardeşin senden ne kadar daha uzun?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ ˈtɔlər ɪz jʊr ˈbrʌðər ðæn ju/
trPron: Hav maç tolır iz yur brazır den yu
collocations: how much taller, taller is your brother
commonMistake: How many taller is your brother? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How much + comparative adjective" (ne kadar daha) iki şey arasındaki farkı sorar.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
topic: How many + fewer (kaç tane daha az)
scenario: How many + fewer + plural noun (kaç tane daha az)
en: How many fewer books do you have than me?
tr: Benden kaç tane daha az kitabın var?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈfjuər bʊks duː juː hæv ðæn mi/
trPron: Hav meni fyur buks du yu hev den mi
collocations: how many fewer books, fewer books do you have
synonyms: kitap, kaç tane daha az, karşılaştırma
commonMistake: How much fewer books? ❌ (less for uncountable)
aiExplain: Comparative"How many fewer" (kaç tane daha az) sayılabilir isimlerde fark sorusu sorar.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
topic: How much + less (ne kadar daha az)
scenario: How much + less + uncountable noun (ne kadar daha az)
en: How much less sugar should I use?
tr: Ne kadar daha az şeker kullanmalıyım?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ lɛs ˈʃʊgər ʃʊd aɪ juz/
trPron: Hav maç les şugır şud ay yuz
collocations: how much less sugar, less sugar should I use
synonyms: şeker, ne kadar daha az, karşılaştırma
commonMistake: How many less sugar? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How much less" (ne kadar daha az) sayılamayan isimlerde fark sorusu sorar.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many times + do/does + subject + verb? (kaç kez)
en: How many times a week do you exercise?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni taɪmz ə wik duː juː ˈɛksərsaɪz/
trPron: Hav meni taymz ı vik du yu eksırsayz
collocations: how many times a week, times a week do you
commonMistake: How much times a week do you exercise? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How many times" (kaç kez) sıklık sorusu sorar. "Times" sayılabilir.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many of + the + plural noun + verb?
en: How many of the students passed the exam?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni əv ðə ˈstudənts pæst ði ɪgˈzæm/
trPron: Hav meni ov dı studınts past di igzam
collocations: how many of the, of the students passed
commonMistake: How much of the students passed? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How many of + the + plural noun" (kaç tane) belirli bir gruptan kaç tanesini sorar.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much of + the + uncountable noun + verb?
en: How much of the information was useful?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ əv ði ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən wʌz ˈjusfəl/
trPron: Hav maç ov di infermeyşın vaz yusfıl
collocations: how much of the, of the information was
commonMistake: How many of the information was useful? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How much of + the + uncountable noun" (ne kadarı) belirli bir miktarın ne kadarını sorar.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + be + noun? (fiyat sorma)
en: How much is this jacket?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ ɪz ðɪs ˈʤækɪt/
trPron: Hav maç iz dis cekit
collocations: how much is, is this jacket
commonMistake: How many is this jacket? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How much" fiyat sormak için kullanılır (sayılamayan para). "How many" kullanılmaz.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + are + plural noun? (fiyat - çoğul)
en: How much are these shoes?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ ɑr ðiz ʃuz/
trPron: Hav maç ar diz şuz
collocations: how much are, are these shoes
commonMistake: How many are these shoes? ❌
aiExplain: CuriousÜrün çoğul olsa bile fiyat sorusu "how much" ile sorulur.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + dollars + do/does + subject + cost? (Kaç dolar - sayılabilir para birimi)
en: How many dollars does this watch cost?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈdɑlərz dʌz ðɪs wɑtʃ kɔst/
trPron: Hav meni dalırz daz dis vaç kost
collocations: how many dollars, dollars does this watch cost
commonMistake: How much does this watch cost? ✔️
aiExplain: Curious"How many dollars" (kaç dolar) sayılabilir para birimi ile fiyat sorar. "How much" daha yaygın.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + does + subject + cost? (Ne kadar - fiyat)
en: How much does this watch cost?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ dʌz ðɪs wɑtʃ kɔst/
trPron: Hav maç daz dis vaç kost
collocations: how much does, does this watch cost
commonMistake: How many does it cost? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How much does it cost?" en yaygın fiyat sorma şeklidir.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
topic: How many (quantity of uncountable in containers)
scenario: How many + container + of + uncountable (kaç kap)
en: How many bottles of water did you buy?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑtəlz əv ˈwɔtər dɪd juː baɪ/
trPron: Hav meni batılz ov vatır did yu bay
collocations: how many bottles, bottles of water did you
commonMistake: How much bottles of water did you buy? ❌
aiExplain: CuriousSayılamayan içecekler (water) için kap (bottles) sayılabilir, "how many" ile sorulur.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
topic: How many (quantity of uncountable in pieces)
scenario: How many + pieces of + uncountable (kaç parça)
en: How many pieces of advice did he give you?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpisɪz əv ædˈvaɪs dɪd hiː gɪv ju/
trPron: Hav meni pisız ov advays did hi giv yu
collocations: how many pieces, pieces of advice did he give
commonMistake: How much pieces of advice did he give you? ❌
aiExplain: CuriousSayılamayan "advice" için "pieces of advice" sayılabilir, "how many" ile sorulur.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + people + verb (kaç kişi)
en: How many people were at the concert?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl wɜr æt ðə ˈkɑnsərt/
trPron: Hav meni pipıl vör at dı konsert
collocations: how many people, people were at the
commonMistake: How much people were at the concert? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"People" sayılabilir bir isimdir (çoğul), "how many" ile kullanılır.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + population + verb? (Ne kadar nüfus - topluluk)
en: How much of the population supports this policy?
tr: Nüfusun ne kadarı bu politikayı destekliyor?

trPron: Hav maç ov dı papyuleyşın süports dis palisi
collocations: how much of the, of the population supports
commonMistake: How many of the population supports this policy? ✔️
aiExplain: Curious"Population" (nüfus) topluluk olarak sayılamayan kabul edilir, "how much" ile kullanılır.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + plural countable noun (countries)

trPron: Hav meni kantriz hev yu vizitıd
collocations: how many countries, countries have you visited
commonMistake: How much countries have you visited? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"Countries" sayılabilir, "how many" ile kullanılır.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + uncountable noun (land)
en: How much land does the farm have?

collocations: how much land, land does the farm have
commonMistake: How many land does the farm have? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"Land" (arazi) sayılamayan, "how much" ile kullanılır.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + plural countable noun (acres)

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How much + uncountable noun (rain, snow)
en: How much rain fell last night?

collocations: how much rain, rain fell last night
commonMistake: How many rain fell last night? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"Rain" (yağmur) sayılamayan, "how much" ile kullanılır.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + plural countable noun (snowflakes)
en: How many snowflakes are there in a snowstorm?
tr: Bir kar fırtınasında kaç kar tanesi vardır?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈsnoʊfleɪks ɑr ðɛr ɪn ə ˈsnoʊstɔrm/
trPron: Hav meni sno fleks ar der in ı snostorm
collocations: how many snowflakes, snowflakes are there in
commonMistake: How much snowflakes are there? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"Snowflakes" (kar taneleri) sayılabilir, "how many" ile kullanılır.

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + times + do/does + number + go into + number? (Kaç kere)

collocations: how many times, times does 5 go into
commonMistake: How much times does 5 go into 20? ❌

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3

collocations: how much is, is 15 plus 27
commonMistake: How many is 15 plus 27? ❌

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3

collocations: how many attempts, attempts did it take you
commonMistake: How much attempts did it take you? ❌

module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P3
scenario: How many + contributions + do/does + subject + make? (Kaç katkı)
